spanish: Y todo el pueblo viendo las voces y las antorchas y la voz de la bocina y el monte humeante; y vio el pueblo, y se estremecieron, y se pararon desde lejos.

units.es: y la voz de la bocina

grammarChanges: Replaced the Hebrew loanword 'shofar' (h02020018010) with the Spanish common noun 'bocina', per the cited auditor fail.
Changed 'del' to 'de la' so the article agrees in gender with the feminine noun 'bocina'.
Added the definite article 'la' before 'voz' to match the definiteness already shown in the parallel phrases 'las voces' and 'las antorchas'.
readerNote: Shofar is rendered as 'bocina' (the ram's-horn trumpet), the Spanish common-noun equivalent, since common nouns cannot stay untranslated.
